findings.claim: On two authenticated original kind-6 four-vertex vehicle polygons in the continuous PR #70 original producer/consumer/GEO state, original callback 0047C8D0 reads view 004C2730 and source records, writes changed projected output records to a separate destination, preserves source bytes and returns EAX=4. The output is repeat-identical in a separately imported GZF project and carries finite coordinates with positive reciprocal depths.
findings.limitations: Ghidra emulated original instructions; projection/preparation was measured but no clip-plane intersection occurred. Harness supplies controlled state and documented services. No draw, framebuffer or pixels.

findings.claim: The original wrapper dispatch is mode-specific: observed kind-6 flags 0x101 select 0047C8D0/0047CE40; kind-10 flags 0x80 select 0047BF00/0047D110; earlier mode 0x15 selects 0047C2F0/00487EA0. These addresses describe distinct dispatch entries rather than conflicting names for one callback.
findings.limitations: Observed callback combinations only; not a complete semantic classification of every mode/table slot. Kind-10 and draw bodies remain service substitutions.

findings.claim: With the same probe and separate unselected target moved behind the view, original traversal produces no polygon wrapper and no kind-6 native callback.
findings.limitations: One controlled behind-view case; it does not test partially clipped input.
